newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Mercator to reduce equity.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Mercator to reduce equity.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Mercator said on Wednesday it would reduce its equity by six percent on June 30, providing shareholders approved the move at a meeting on June 20.

"The number of our shares will be decreased to 3,142,540 from 3,344,240," said Ales Cerin, consultant to Mercator's president. "The aim of the move is to decrease equity capital and thus raise profit per share."
Mercator's shares are listed on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse and have a nominal value of 10,000 tolars each.
Mercator operates in the domestic retail and wholesale market, managing over 650 stores and a number of food processing companies.
At 1020 GMT Mercator shares were 0.8 percent up at 4,467 tolars.
-- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 154.6 Slovenian Tolars)
